doc: Named skies for the build panel's preset row — authoring conveniences, applied to the sliders and PREVIEWED; only the commit button writes to the world, and it writes concrete args (the log never stores a preset name, so logged meaning never depends on this file). Keys are sky-verb args: hours/rate/azimuth/sun/ambient/fill/exposure/fog numeric, clouds/weather strings. Named times beat eight raw sliders for the 95% case — you want "golden", not hours=17.4.
